items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Betsy (Inaudible) the name of that Billy club where Benny used to go all night long.

ctx.x: So it's all Duke to me. (Inaudible) And I'm sure that's why Billy Strayhorn felt the same way because he stayed like that with Duke. More so, because I was in the bar with Billy Strayhorn while he was composing "Lush Life," after our club in California. I've for- Dexter Gordon would know; I'll have to ask Dexter gotten the name of it. Betsy (Inaudible) the name of that Billy club where Benny used to go all night long. He used to hang out there all the time, drinking, and going to the piano.
